text: The navigation attempt adds a guard before reading a tree selection and uses the actual window.parent for standalone message closure. Fixed rowCountChanged further handles a missing gDBView through optional chaining. It preserves the suppress/adjust/restore sequence only while a selection exists. That is a lifecycle guard, not proof the intermittent timeout was cured. Required numbered Bug comments are missing and review remains unread. No browser test or native window action ran.
title: Standalone message tree callbacks tolerate a released selection
